app.title: Fence Cost Calculator
app.subtitle: Estimate the cost of your fence project

start.heading: Welcome
start.description: This tool helps you estimate the cost of your brick fencing project. Configure your fence step by step and get an instant quote.

dimensions.heading: Wall Dimensions
dimensions.description: Enter the overall length and height of your fence.

bond.heading: Bond Pattern
bond.description: Choose a brick bond pattern for your fence.
bond.stretcherDesc: Most common pattern. Bricks staggered by half in each row.
bond.stackDesc: Bricks stacked directly on top of each other. Simple and strong.
bond.headerDesc: All headers laid lengthwise. Strong and uniform appearance.
bond.englishDesc: Alternating courses of stretchers and headers. Very strong.
bond.flemishGardenDesc: Shifted headers and stretchers in a garden wall layout.

pier.heading: Pier Layout
pier.description: Configure brick-built piers and the wall bays between them.
pier.timberFenceHint: Choose what to place between piers above the wall.
pier.heightHint: Set the overall pier height. Piers will not render lower than the wall itself.
pier.spacingHint: Centres are snapped in 0.24m brick modules and must stay at or below 3.0m.

typeDesc.none: Keep the wall as one continuous bonded face.
typeDesc.hidden: Build brick piers behind the wall so only their top section reads clearly from the front.
typeDesc.exposed: Build full-height brick piers and separate the wall into bays between them.

sizeDesc.1_5x1: Narrow brick pier using a 1.5-brick front with 1-brick depth.
sizeDesc.1_5x1_5: Recommended minimum pier with a 1.5-brick front and deeper core.
sizeDesc.2x1: Wider 2-brick front pier with a slimmer depth.
sizeDesc.2x2: Largest standard pier in the current model, 2 bricks wide and 2 bricks deep.

timberFenceDesc.none: Only show the brick wall and piers.
timberFenceDesc.timber: Draw two yellow rails between each pair of piers above the wall.
timberFenceDesc.pvc: Draw two light PVC rails between each pair of piers above the wall.

cutBricks.heading: Cut Bricks
cutBricks.description: Choose whether wall bays may use cut bricks at their ends.

optionDesc.allowed: Use the current implementation, which can trim end bricks where needed.
optionDesc.notAllowed: Use only full/half brick outcomes with shorter or longer bay adjustments.

cutBricks.note: No-cut mode snaps wall bays and overall wall length to the nearest valid brick layout.

diagram.awaitingDimensions: Enter wall dimensions to see a preview.

cost.heading: Cost Estimate
cost.description: Here is your estimated fence cost breakdown.
cost.disclaimer: This is an estimate only. Actual costs may vary based on materials, labor, and site conditions.

quotes.title: My Saved Quotes
quotes.empty: No saved quotes yet. Create a cost estimate and save it!
quotes.willOverwrite: A quote with this name already exists and will be overwritten.
quotes.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this quote?

cookie.message: This site uses cookies and local storage to save your preferences and project data.
